classification.difficultyReason: Find the percentage volume, then apply a price per 100 mL to that volume.

content.prompt: The label on a $750\text{ mL}$ bottle of soft drink states that it contains $15\%$ pure mango juice.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How many millilitres of mango juice does it contain?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Volume of mango juice}&=\frac{15}{100}\times750\text{ mL}\\\text{Volume of mango juice}&=112.5\text{ mL}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: If pure mango juice costs $25$ cents per $100\text{ mL}$, what is the value of the mango juice in the bottle? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Value of }1\text{ mL}&=\frac{25}{100}\text{ cents}\\\text{Value of }112.5\text{ mL}&=112.5\times\frac{25}{100}\text{ cents}\\\text{Value of }112.5\text{ mL}&=28.125\text{ cents}.\end{align*}$$

The value is $28$ cents to the nearest cent.
